y-m-50-04.title: Ukuba umsebenzi odityanisiweyo uyi-one-to-one, ingaba yomibini imisebenzi iyi-one-to-one?
y-m-50-04.topic: Esinokuthi ngo-f no-g xa umsebenzi odityanisiweyo g∘f uyi-one-to-one
y-m-50-04.goal: Fumana amaxabiso omsebenzi odityanisiweyo ngqo ukusuka kwitheyibhile enikiweyo ukuvavanya isibakala sika-Eunsu, uze ucacise ukuba inxalenye enye yesibakala iphulwa njani ngumzekelo ochasayo ngelixa enye isebenza.

g(a)=p, g(b)=q, g(c)=p

Isibakala sika-Eunsu: "Ukuba u-g∘f ngumsebenzi we-one-to-one, ngoko bobabini u-f no-g bangemisebenzi ye-one-to-one."

y-m-50-06.title: Ukuba siphakamisa umgca, ingaba inani lamanqaku okudibana liya kuqhubeka likhula?
y-m-50-06.topic: Inani lokudibana kwegrafu yomsebenzi ongeyo-rational y=√(x-1)+2 nomgca y=x+k (indlela etshintsha ngayo ngo-k)
y-m-50-06.goal: Vavanya ngamaxabiso athile ingcinga yokuba inani lamanqaku okudibana litshintsha ngokuzinzileyo njengoko umgca uhamba kwicala elinye, ufumane amaxabiso amaninzi aneliselayo imeko, uze uchaze ukuba inani lamanqaku okudibana lixhomekeke koluhlu lwe-k.
y-m-50-06.material:
Igrafu yomsebenzi f(x)=√(x-1)+2 (x≥1) yijiko eliqala kwinqaku (1, 2) kwaye linyuka kancinci ukuya ekunene. (√ ifundwa 'intsika yesikwere', kwaye √(x-1) yi-'ntsika yesikwere ye-x ukususa 1'.) Imizekelo yamaxabiso: f(1)=2, f(2)=3, f(5)=4, f(10)=5.
Sihambisa umgca y=x+k (ithambeka 1, k yi-constant) phezulu naphantsi. USeohyun uthi, "Ukuba k iba nkulu, umgca uyanyuka, ngoko inani lamanqaku apho udibana khona negrafu liqhubeka likhula."

Isiseko: cinga ukuba sele uyazi ukuba igrafu yomsebenzi ongeyo-rational y=√(x-p)+q iqala kwinqaku (p, q) kwaye ijija ngaphezulu ukuya ekunene, ukuba ingaphakathi lentsika yesikwere kufuneka libe li-0 okanye ngaphezulu, inani leengcambu zenkcazelo yesibini nediskrimineyiti, nokujonga ukudibana kweegrafu njengezisombululo zeenkcazelo ezilinganayo ngaxeshanye.

y-m-50-02.topic: Ukumisela iimpawu zamakoyifishenti ngenkcazo yegrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic y=ax²+bx+c (ukwanela kolwazi)

(다) Incopho ingasekunene kwe-eksisi ye-y. (Ikhowudinethi ye-x yencopho ipositivu.)
